probe_validity.state_alignment_with_previous_report: matched by episode_seed, macro_index, origin_index, slot, ordered production candidate IDs, sampled action, sampled duration, and P_KEEP
probe_validity.formal_actor_evaluator: DualTimescaleActorCritic.evaluate_macro (current formal method; this checkout has no evaluate_macro_actions symbol)
probe_validity.formal_actor_loss: current trainer clipped joint Cache+Duration PPO surrogate over all Macro transitions in the episode; no Cache-only split

cache_shadow_score_definition.name: CACHE_SHADOW_SCORE
cache_shadow_score_definition.duration: same transition's sampled, realized duration L in {1,3,5}
cache_shadow_score_definition.micro_policy: same frozen checkpoint Micro policy; each candidate restores the same post-Macro RNG state
cache_shadow_score_definition.matching_kkt: formal execute_configured_slot implementation with per-slot shared caches
cache_shadow_score_definition.candidate_set: all formal production candidates from the matched rollout; candidate 0 is KEEP

formal_objective_definition.episode_loss: mean of the current trainer clipped actor surrogate across the complete episode Macro buffer
formal_objective_definition.local_loss: the same clipped joint actor surrogate for one transition using that transition's normalized SMDP-GAE

fixed_l3_vs_sampled_l.interaction_rule: strict majority of fixed-L3 UPDATE states flip to sampled-duration KEEP

decision.interpretation: Directional derivatives are computed from autograd on Macro Actor parameters; positive log-odds direction favors UPDATE. CACHE_SHADOW_SCORE is a finite sampled-duration counterfactual score, not global exact Q.
